custom.description: Gameplay stains over the original textured enamel
Cosmetic squash/stretch; collision shapes stay stable
custom.code: float h=clamp(1+S,.65,1.4); float w=rsqrt(h); return float3(P.xy*(w-1),P.z*(h-1));

float enamel=smoothstep(.20,.48,min(Enamel.r,min(Enamel.g,Enamel.b)));
return lerp(Base,.43,Stain.x*enamel*.85);
return lerp(Base,max(Base,.68),max(Fracture.x*.4,Fracture.y));
